freeze_rules: Three predeclared task-seed pairs, four settings each, sequential single Unity environment.
All use fixed 20-step windows: preset horizons are 50,35,120 respectively. Report partial progress and window success, not full-horizon failure.
New compact context source, no peer map-cache duplication or empty stage fields. HA has state only, no leader instruction. HR lists allowed recipients and aggregates feedback.
Ordinary local-no-delta remains logged but does not trigger leader messages. No new capacity planner, semantic guard or workflow.
P baseline prompt/delivery unchanged. HG experimental library retained but excluded from this batch.
Original validators unchanged. Full_Game game_type5 validator is fire-based, not a conjunction of every narrative objective; report fire/civilian/transport/damage counters separately.
No fixed fire denominator, goal fraction/AUC null for Full_Game. Tree score reports initial value and delta.
Gate uses separate 2-step runs with actual 10/14/15 counts; excluded from task comparisons.
Include all failures/timeouts and unknown outcomes. No outcome-driven retries or behavior changes within batch.
Compare settings within each task-seed. This is not a controlled scaling curve, since task/map/workload also differ. No old-vs-compact efficacy claim without matched old-source trials.
Raw prompts/chats, observations, action results, recipient delivery/suppression, PNGs and returned usage retained.
